name: Iceland
description: Iceland from Norse settlement and the Althing to the sagas, Danish rule, independence, the Cod Wars and volcanoes.

checkpoints.name: The commonwealth
checkpoints.note: Norse settlers came from 874, founded the Althing in 930, and wrote the sagas.

checkpoints.name: Norway and Denmark
checkpoints.note: Iceland came under Norway and then Denmark. Laki's eruption brought famine.

checkpoints.name: Independent Iceland
checkpoints.note: Iceland won home rule in 1918 and became a republic in 1944.
